name: Dranik Causeway
summary: A shattered elevated roadway linking the city’s districts, fractured by Discord ruptures and patrolled by Muramite forces.
description: Dranik Causeway once served as the main artery of the Dranik capital, connecting citadels, wards, and defensive towers. Now it lies broken, suspended over Discord‑scarred terrain. Muramite patrols sweep the causeway, Discord ruptures tear through its structure, and temporal echoes replay the siege that shattered it.
